CHA.name: Change
CHA.framework_role: Use derivatives to describe rates of change and definite integrals to describe net change; connect differentiation and integration through the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.

LIM.name: Limits
LIM.framework_role: Use limiting processes to develop and justify central calculus ideas including continuity, differentiation, and integration.

FUN.name: Analysis of Functions
FUN.framework_role: Analyze function behavior by connecting limits, derivatives, integrals, and their representations.

skills.1.A: Identify the question/problem (instructional skill; not assessed directly).
skills.1.B: Identify key and relevant information (instructional skill; not assessed directly).
skills.1.C: Select an appropriate rule/procedure from the expression structure.
skills.1.D: Select an appropriate rule/procedure from relationships among concepts/processes.
skills.1.E: Apply appropriate mathematical rules/procedures, with and without technology.
skills.1.F: Explain how an approximation relates to the actual value.

skills.2.A: Identify common structures across contextual situations.
skills.2.B: Identify information from graphical, numerical, analytical, or verbal representations.
skills.2.C: Re-express mathematical information in another representation.
skills.2.D: Identify how function characteristics/properties relate across representations.
skills.2.E: Describe relationships among representations of functions and derivatives.

skills.3.A: Use technology to develop claims/conjectures (instructional skill; not assessed directly).
skills.3.B: Identify an appropriate definition, theorem, or test.
skills.3.D: Apply the selected definition, theorem, or test.
skills.3.E: Provide reasons/rationales for solutions and conclusions.
skills.3.F: Explain the meaning of mathematical solutions in context.
skills.3.G: Confirm solutions are accurate and appropriate.

calculator_and_exam.course_use: Technology is an integral exploratory and problem-solving tool; students should connect calculator output to mathematical meaning rather than treat output as proof.
required_capabilities: graph a function in an arbitrary window
calculator_and_exam.frq_setup_rule: When a required calculator capability produces a free-response result, students should write the mathematical setup leading to the result as well as the result.
exploration_examples: use a table to conjecture a limit
visualize Riemann sums approaching a definite integral
draw/investigate slope fields and initial conditions
